_deal: The live local-cargo pool, as every lettered recipe since 2026-10-12.
author: jessica, as Momo Hazuki
source: his 2026-10-12 18:34: "try Momo now", after 16a under Vance
_note: THE SECOND PEN-NAME DELVE, at the opposite end from 16a. home-office office/pennames/momo-hazuki.json: a good
day, nothing lost, 'the stakes are whether the ice lolly melts'. Snacks, timings, who is back when. One run-on
when she gets excited. Never finds anything remarkable. Her tell, kept: she checks the time and is pleased.
Her heat does not apply (Overtime is adult, not explicit, his 10-12). Her world and voice do.
Beats are 16a's: talk, two pickups, a deliver that speaks. Nothing new to build.
THE MELT IS REAL (his 2026-10-12 19:28: "go on, make it a real timer. We can have Mission failure as well,
theres a failed objective animation"). See `deadline`, PROPOSED: the recipe is the ask (his 10-12).
Voiced lines: no names, no places, no flags. She has seven colleagues and names none of them.
MODELS: the freight crate stands in for a cool box (Kim's list); the picnic blanket is 13a's, his eye owed.

place._theme: A worked site with a small team on it. She is placed by the talk beat: NonHostile mostly has nobody.

prose.name: Errand: Cool Box on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Someone at the <Place> has lost a cool box off a hauler. The posting has three exclamation marks and promises a lolly.

beats.objective: Talk to the organiser at the <Place>
beats.journal: The organiser at the <Place> lost the cool box for the team's Friday lollies off a hauler. It's out on the site somewhere, with a bag of cups. She says there's five minutes before they go soft.

person.name: Tess Ambry
person._elevenlabs: Placeholder again. She wants bright and quick. His ear.

beats.greeting: You came! Brilliant. Okay. The cool box fell off the hauler, which is fine, but the lollies are in it, which is less fine.

exchanges.reply: Hero! It's blue. Probably blue. The cups fell off too, grab those. Five minutes before they go soft. Loads of time!
It's Friday! The fourth one, which is lolly Friday, which nobody voted for, I just started doing it and now there's a rota and a song.

exchanges.prompt: How many of you are there?
exchanges.reply: Seven! One won't eat the orange ones, so really six and a half, and I eat the half. It's a system.
Obviously! Whoever saves lolly Friday gets first pick. I just made that up. It's a rule now.

beats._talk: PROPOSED fields, as 14a. Exchange 0 ends the conversation and sets the first pickup's stage. Exchange 2 is her one run-on territory; exchange 3 is the flirt the ceiling allows, and she does not notice it is one, which is the Momo answer.

message.title: Cool Box
message.text: Upside down, latch still shut. It sloshes a bit. That's probably the ice. It is not blue.

message.title: Bag of Cups
message.text: Paper cups and a roll of napkins. Someone has written FRIDAY on the bag and drawn a sun with a face.

beats.journal: Somebody's Friday lollies fell off a hauler at the <Place>. I found the cool box and the cups and brought them back. I got first pick. It's a rule now.
beats.name: Lolly Friday
beats.say: You found it! Still cold, feel, it's still cold! And we've got loads of time. Here. Have a red one. The red ones are the best ones.

fail.say: Oh! That's five minutes. They're soup now. Lolly soup! Honestly, that's still a good Friday.
fail.journal: Somebody's Friday lollies fell off a hauler at the <Place>. I didn't get the cool box back before they melted. She called it lolly soup and didn't seem to mind.

_deadline: PROPOSED. Starts when beat 1 (the talk) completes, i.e. on exchange 0. If beat 4 (the deliver) has not
completed after `seconds`, the quest FAILS: every open objective shows failed (his 'failed objective
animation'), `fail.say` plays in the speaker's voice, `fail.journal` is the journal, and the quest stops.
MECHANISM, from Eliza's own code (gen_delve_beats.cs:40-45): NOT StartTimer, whose OnTimer never fires in a
fragment; a Utility.Wait in beat 1's completion fragment, then a stage check, as the stuck guard does.
300 s, not her original twenty minutes: the cells sit 53 to 96 m out (p25 to p75, the lint's separation),
so the route is about 275 m at the median and twenty minutes could never run out. His to tune.
WANTED from the build: the carried items (Cool Box, Bag of Cups) removed on failure, or they sit in the
inventory as the lint already warns for an undelivered pickup.
The fail line obeys Momo's cartridge: nothing sad, never quieter than it started.

broadcast: Hi! Hello! Small emergency, but a nice one. Our cool box fell off a hauler and it's full of lollies. Anyone nearby? There's one in it for you!
_speech: Her voice on the radio, in person and at the end. No names, no places, no flags.
